record.description_evidence:
The AI job search that writes a tailored resume for every match.

Most resume tools tailor for one job. Most job sites flood you with postings. Jobbi does both at once.

Tap Find 10 fresh jobs. Jobbi scans live postings from Anthropic, Stripe, Vercel, Notion, Airbnb, and 40 more companies hiring right now. It ranks them by fit to your background, then writes a tailored resume and cover letter for each one. Run it again whenever. You'll never see the same role twice.

Already have a job in mind? The Tools tab gives you a one-shot tailored resume or cover letter from any job description you paste.

HOW IT WORKS

Add your experience once.
Tap Find 10 fresh jobs, or paste a single job description.
Get tailored resumes and cover letters in seconds.
Export to PDF and apply.
FREE
· One full hunt: 10 jobs, 10 resumes, 10 cover letters
· Unlimited single-job tailoring
· Match score on every job
· PDF and Word export
· ATS-friendly formatting

PRO
· Unlimited job-search runs
· Cover letters that sound like you wrote them yourself

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Your name, phone, email, and address never leave your device. The AI sees placeholders, not your real info. Real details get filled in locally before the PDF.

We can't see your data, because we never receive it.

Get the interview. That's the whole point.

record.description_evidence:
Stop sending the same resume to every job.

Velora tailors your resume to a real job posting, then helps you practice the interview for that exact role.

Built from your real experience. No fake skills. No generic prep.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Upload the resume you already have — PDF or from your library.
2. Paste the exact job posting you're applying to.
3. Velora tailors your resume to that role: the right keywords, the strengths that matter, and clearer role fit.
4. Generate a matching cover letter written from your real background and that specific job.
5. Practice an AI interview built from the same job and your tailored resume.

NOT A RESUME BUILDER
Velora doesn't start you from a blank page or a template. It improves the resume you already have and aligns it to the role you actually want — so every application is targeted instead of generic.

TAILOR, DON'T FABRICATE
Velora works only from the experience you provide. It never invents skills, employers, or achievements. Your resume stays honest — just sharper and better matched to the job.

PRACTICE THE REAL INTERVIEW
Get role-specific questions drawn from the job posting and your tailored resume, plus recruiter-style feedback on your answers — so you walk in prepared instead of guessing.

MATCHING COVER LETTERS
Generate a cover letter that fits the role, written from your resume and the job description. No filler, no templates.

SEE WHAT CHANGED
Understand the keywords, strengths, and role-fit behind every tailored resume, so you know why it's a better match.

PRIVACY & TRUST
Your resume and job details are used to prepare your application and interview practice — nothing more. Real experience only. Nothing is invented.

Velora is built for job seekers applying to real roles in the US who want every application to feel targeted, and every interview to feel rehearsed.

Build your resume, tailor it to the job, generate a matching cover letter, and practice for the interview - all powered by one profile.

No login required to get started.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Import an existing resume PDF or LinkedIn export - no retyping
• Build from scratch with structured, step-by-step guidance
• See your ATS score and pinpoint exactly what to fix before applying
• Paste a job description to tailor your resume and highlight matching skills
• Generate a tailored cover letter written from your real background
• Practice role-specific interview questions with actionable feedback
• Export clean PDFs, Word documents, or plain text with zero watermarks

ONE PROFILE, EVERY APPLICATION

Most resume apps make you start from scratch every time. AI Resume Builder maintains a single, structured profile of your career. Tailor each resume in seconds so your fifth application takes minutes instead of an hour.

TAILORED TO THE JOB, NOT GENERIC

Paste any job posting. The app analyzes what the employer is looking for, reorders and rewrites your real experience to match, and highlights requirements your profile doesn't cover yet so you know exactly where you stand.

AI THAT DOESN'T MAKE THINGS UP

The app only works with what you've actually done. It never invents jobs, fake metrics, or unearned qualifications, and it never borrows requirements from the posting to create false claims.

27 ATS-FRIENDLY & PROFESSIONAL TEMPLATES

• 5 strictly machine-readable, single-column ATS layouts
• Modern, executive, compact, and creative formats
• Designs with or without profile photos
• Formatted for US Letter and A4 with customizable accent colors

INTERVIEW PREP FROM YOUR PROFILE

Walk into the room ready. Practice questions generated directly from your background and the target role, complete with model answers and tips to frame your answers confidently.

PRIVACY FIRST

Your career data stays securely on your device by default. Sign in only if you choose to sync across devices - an account is never required to build, edit, or export.

AI Resume Matchmaker is your personal AI-powered resume assistant that helps you instantly generate contextually tailored, job-specific resumes for every role you apply to using AI. It’s fast, accurate, effortless — and designed to help you land more interviews, faster.

Why use AI Resume Matchmaker?
Let’s face it: sending the same resume to every job doesn't work anymore.

Recruiters use filters, scanners, and keyword-based algorithms. You need a resume that matches the job perfectly. That’s where AI Resume Matchmaker comes in — giving you a personalized and customized resume built to align with each job description, boosting your chances of getting seen and hired.

Whether you’re applying for Product, UX, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Entry-Level or any type of roles, this app turns your existing resume into a job-winning version tailored to each opportunity.

Key Benefits:
• Generate custom resumes for every job — instantly
• Match your resume to the job description using advanced AI
• Save, manage, and reuse tailored resumes for each role
• Export polished professional resumes as PDFs — optimized for ATS (Applicant Tracking System) scanners
• No design skills or writing required
• Submit with confidence, knowing your resume is a match

Use-Cases:
• Trying to beat the competition from other candidates and get the job you are applying for
• Targeting different industries or seniority levels
• Applying to competitive roles where every word counts
• Need a resume tailored to freelance gigs, startups, corporate jobs or any role

How It Works:
1. Enter your current resume in any format
2. Paste in a job description or job link (LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.)
3. Tap "Create Resume"
4. Instantly get a customized, role-specific professional resume
5. Save, export as PDF, apply

Power Features:
• Role-based Resume Matching – One-click tailoring based on keywords, tone, and job description context
• AI-driven Resume Optimization – Trained to highlight the right experience and rewrite weak sections
• Save & Organize Resume Versions – Keep track of which resume went to which job
• PDF Export & History Access – Quick export for job portals, or re-download past versions anytime
• Lightning-Fast Turnaround – Create or customize a resume in under 10 seconds
• Modern, clean formatting — Designed to make a strong first impression

Who is This App For?
• First-time job seekers trying to stand out
• Mid-career professionals changing industries
• Tech workers applying across different roles
• Freelancers pitching to multiple clients
• Executives or consultants building role-specific documents
• Anyone tired of endlessly rewriting their resume

Safe, Secure, Private:
Your content is never stored or shared. You control your data and your documents.

Don’t just apply — apply smarter.
Make sure your resume speaks the language of the job.
Download AI Resume Matchmaker now and take control of your job search with precision, speed, and confidence.
